label: Instance infra status
description: Read the state of one instance's copy of an infra node: `none` when it was never started (or was terminated), else provisioning, running, flaky, stopping, stopped, terminating or failed. A start or stop on its way reads provisioning or stopping at once, the same answer `weft status` gives.

inputs.name: node
inputs.description: The infra node marked `@per_instance`, named the way the program writes it (`bridge`, or `one.bridge` inside an included file).

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: The instance, by the id your program gives it (`user-42`).

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: The copy's state, `none` when there is no copy.

outputs.name: running
outputs.description: True when the copy answers now.

then.message: InstanceInfraStatus '{id}' names {names} in `node`, which is no infra node of this program marked `@per_instance`. Name one the way the program writes it (`bridge`, or `one.bridge` inside an included file).
